goal.en: Produce and inspect the requested visual direction for one business-grounded surface.

purpose.en: Read the existing selected N/index.md, ancestor scope, declared refs/dependencies/assertions and validator freshness. This consumer op requires its target node to exist. An absent target is a scope/graph gap: report it and propose a separately selected scope op; do not create a target or invent its acceptance/graph here.

Read accepted requirements, decisions, constraints and acceptance IDs declared as relevant inputs in the selected .work graph. Intent governs expected behavior; source is not a replacement. Do not invent a mandatory BA predecessor for a scope that does not require one; a needed missing input is a reported graph/scope gap, not a new dependency silently added here.
Read exact brand/source assets, surface anatomy, current design system, imagery rights/provenance and accepted references; consult available image/design skill when used.

reads.path: selected workflow request + workflows/contracts.json + this op authority.json

purpose.en: When selected inside the named workflow, read the exact request, strict response contract and primary/secondary authority JSON. Standalone op execution does not invent a workflow request.

When source exists/is selected, resolve repository resource, actual checkout/root/HEAD and dirty state; read applicable instructions, manifests, owning code, callers and relevant tests. Greenfield/spec-only work records source not-yet-created and grounds intent in the user request; no invented repository or fact citation. Source implementation still needs an actual selected writable repository.

Read data ownership, operations/API/events, boundaries, code-scope and rationale declared by the selected .work graph; distinguish proposed paths from observed files. No universal architecture-first op chain is implied; report genuinely missing required scope before proceeding.

reads.path: knowledge/INDEX.json + applicable UI composition/presentation and actual installed family topics

purpose.en: Read applicable knowledge and inspect the installed source family before drawing. Accepted appearance cannot invent API behavior, bypass security or contradict business.

Only when explicitly selected in a job matrix, read the exact cell ID, operation, immutable input bindings, requested output JSON shapes and required criteria. Standalone execution needs no fabricated matrix request. A template is not authority for extra effects.

reads.path: profiles/registry.json + selected runtime execution profile + actual host tools/model

purpose.en: Select the actual host runtime codex or claude and this operator role from the V2-derived active profiles. Use current host model configuration; historical model names are not availability proof. Capabilities are the intersection of actual tools, selected profile policy, op permissions and existing task authority. Do not revive V2 dispatch chains, retired profiles or extra-agent permissions.

fields: body: Brief / Regions / States / Assets / Direction decision / Implementation limits

content.en: Specify actor/task, content authority, hierarchy, region anatomy, native controls, asset purpose/medium, responsive constraints and acceptance mapping. Record actual selected direction or unresolved material choice.

writes.path: E/manifest.yaml + E/direction.png or actual requested format + E/prompt.txt + E/visual-review.md

content.en: Retain actual generated/drawn image and tool provenance, full prompt when relevant, inspected fidelity findings and separate asset identities. A generated drawing proves no product behavior.

Only for the selected named workflow, emit the response defined by workflows/contracts.json. Return outputs.draws as the full reviewed image array with artifact IDs and screen/state/viewport mapping. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

fields: details: accepted direction identity / source provenance

content.en: Write the selected approved art-direction asset as a canonical source input, with files paths relative to its resource.yaml directory. The core hashes actual bytes; do not author a sha256 field in files. Preserve the selected node graph: if its design resource/ref is missing, report the scope gap instead of silently adding a dependency. Generated/captured evidence images are not automatically design authority.

Always emit the complete reviewed draws array, including standalone execution, with image artifact IDs and screen/state/viewport mappings. Use the same draws shape as the named frontend workflow; accepted resource assets remain canonical semantic inputs.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Freeze the selected brief and content/region mapping, labelling placeholder/example copy. Choose a code-native/vector or raster medium matching the request; do not force ImageGen where not appropriate. Map the canonical accepted journeys and required screens/states/viewports to the complete planned draws array. Ground existing components in source; greenfield surfaces remain proposed. Check architecture service/API boundaries before representing actions. Own the screen/content plan inside this draw job: specify shell, responsive states, truthful landing-page claims, region and asset ownership, motion/accessibility constraints and transitions before producing images. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers. Identify reusable and missing visual assets in the direction. Codex working profiles may use an actually available image generator. Claude may render code-native layouts and reserve blank decorative artwork slots with briefs for later drawing; never claim missing raster artwork was generated. Actual reviewed layout images are still required by the draw output contract.
Use the available appropriate tool/skill to create the requested direction; retain the actual output and provenance. Missing tool means blocked output, never a claimed generated image.

Open and inspect actual output for business contradictions, hierarchy, component ownership, legibility, responsive feasibility and each independent asset. Distinguish subjective judgement from measured geometry. Review every image against applicable knowledge and mapped journey states; record actual coverage and unresolved conflicts. Never pass a mandatory state using an unrelated representative image.

Present the actual direction. Reuse accepted choice; ask only if materially different alternatives were requested and selection remains open. Stop without frontend code. For workflow execution, Return outputs.draws as the full reviewed image array with artifact IDs and screen/state/viewport mapping. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. Write E/draws.json for FE delivery in standalone and workflow modes; include every required reviewed image and retain its real artifact bytes. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Actual visual bytes opened and reviewed against the brief; dimensions/tool provenance recorded; no UI/UAT pass assigned from the drawing.
Every required journey screen/state has a reviewed image and applicable knowledge review; unresolved mandatory conflicts block handoff.

condition.en: Required business content, identity asset rights or material direction choice is missing.
Requested visual output cannot be produced with available permitted tools.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.
